title: Laboratory to Launchpad: Bringing Your Energy IP to Life
description: Laboratory to Launchpad: Bringing Your Energy IP to Life was a one-day conference held on June 11, 2026, at the Hopkins Bloomberg Center in Washington, D.C. The conference brought together faculty, students, postdocs, researchers, and other innovators interested in moving research toward application. Sessions covered commercialization, intellectual property, federal funding, startup formation, research communication, and other aspects of translating research beyond the laboratory.
highlights: A featured talk by Dr. David Gates, CTO of Thea Energy
Workshops on pitching research, securing federal funding, intellectual property, licensing, and startup growth
A working lunch panel on cross-disciplinary innovation and translational research
A live pitch competition with judges from D.C. venture capital firms
A networking reception to close the day

title: Quantum Computing in Practice: Hands On with Quantinuum
description: Quantum Computing in Practice: Hands On with Quantinuum was a two-day workshop on quantum computing and its applications across chemistry, physics, materials science, biology, engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence. The program included talks, discussions, research presentations, and hands-on tutorials using Quantinuum hardware and software.

sessions.presenter: Dr. Corey Oses and Dr. Gregory Quiroz
sessions.description: Please register HERE. A $50 registration fee is required to reserve your spot for this two-day workshop. If the cost poses a barrier, please contact the organizers.

title: Data-Driven Materials Modeling Workshop
description: The first Data-Driven Materials Modeling Workshop was held May 29–31, 2024. Each day combined morning seminars with hands-on sessions in the afternoon. The seminars introduced data-driven approaches for experimental and computational materials research, and the hands-on sessions gave students experience implementing the methods with guidance from graduate students and postdoctoral researchers.
